jyutping: zaa1 syun4 waan4 jau4 sai3 gaai3

english.note: Use this specifically when someone sails around the world rather than merely travelling around it by unspecified means.

examples.english: They plan to circumnavigate the world by boat after retiring and take photos along the way.
examples.traditional: 佢哋退休後打算揸船環遊世界，仲話要沿途影相。
